### How Believers Will Be Judged
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/how-believers-will-be-judged
Passage: Revelation 20:12
Points:
- God keeps a complete record of every person's deeds, thoughts, and words.
- Sins and shortcomings of believers are revealed only as forgiven failures covered by Jesus' blood.
- The record of believers' failures is consumed and removed from judgment rather than condemning them.
- Good works produced by God's grace and Spirit bear witness to eternal life and receive heavenly rewards.
- Eternal life itself is received not by human merit, but as a free gift of grace through faith in Christ.

### The Great White Throne Judgment
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-great-white-throne-judgment
Passage: Revelation 20:11-15
Points:
- The great white throne emphasizes the absolute purity, righteousness, and wisdom of God's final judgment.
- All the dead will experience resurrection to stand before God and give an account.
- Salvation depends solely on whether a person's name is recorded in the Book of Life by faith in Christ.
- While good works never merit eternal life, God uses them to determine distinct rewards in glory.
- Those outside Christ, along with death and Hades, face permanent separation from God in the lake of fire.
